why: Both analyses land on the key's durable-housewares hedgehog, the 15%/launch-cadence stop-doing items, the brutal facts and the Stage 2 decline path, but Analysis 2 builds order-fill reliability and net SKU pruning into the hedgehog and stop-doing list, which is closer to the key. Analysis 1 has the tighter one-screen verdict and is a little more careful about flagging the resin-earnings link as an assumption, but Analysis 2 is the more complete and actionable hand-off for the leader.
